description: The ALB WAF spec documents no 404 on DeleteCustomRuleGroup, but the API returns 404 for a custom rule group that does not exist: STACKIT's own Terraform provider (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/albwaf/custom_rule_group/resource.go, Delete, read 2026-11-01) treats http.StatusNotFound as already deleted. Type it as the model's NotFound so callers can tell a missing rule group from other failures.
